preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore uninterrupted fresh deployment through the 3/5/10 Alpha-Bravo-Charlie encounter route, then establish clip-safe enemy-shot feedback and a bounded state-driven mission audio/VFX layer without changing authoritative combat or mission commits, the intact authored environment, or preserved controls and enemy identities.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two integration boundaries are failing. First, arena_foundation.gd builds one concave collision body from every visible authored-map mesh, then accepts navigation-projected anchors and centerline casts without proving standing-capsule occupancy or continuous grounded traversal. This can place the player against decorative or duplicated collision near the deployment route; adjusting spawn transforms again would leave the collision topology defect intact. Second, fps_shot_feedback_3d.gd sends enemy-to-player character hits through the same world-space impact branch as remote character hits and places additive geometry at the player capsule hit point near the camera. Scaling that geometry still leaves the wrong presentation channel. MissionController already emits immutable mission events, but the complete event-specific audio/VFX consumer and receipts remain absent or unproven.

stop_conditions: Do not work around the route defect by disabling player/world collision, teleporting during ordinary traversal, moving the intact authored environment, replacing native streets with proxy floors, or changing the preserved 3/5/10 roster.
Do not accept a spawn or reset destination unless a standing-capsule occupancy query, ground support result, and first route segment are all valid in the same transformed world space.
Do not let presentation code create or repeat ammo, damage, score, objective, checkpoint, or terminal state; every cue must observe an immutable authoritative event ID.
Stop the focused implementation pass if clean boot, scene imports, required node bindings, or parser checks regress; repair that regression before runtime testing.

Developer self-validation ends with the focused same-workspace retest. GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester own continuous replay recapture, distributed-frame evidence, formal issue closure, and phase verdicts.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from transform or effect-scale tuning: isolate the collision sources that actually define walkable structural geometry and validate capsule occupancy before committing deployment anchors; independently route local-player hits to damage/HUD feedback while reserving world impacts for remote characters and real surfaces. Reuse MissionController's immutable event stream to add missing player-facing mission cues rather than synthesizing state in presentation.

code: Run Godot import/parser validation and the frozen clean_boot check on the exact candidate workspace; require no new script, scene, resource, or signal-binding errors.
Inspect the authored environment binding to confirm exactly one visible environment instance remains and no authored child mesh, wrapper transform, or raw imported source was modified.
Verify collision diagnostics and feedback receipts are candidate runtime state only, bounded in size, and hidden from the normal player-facing HUD.
Verify presentation observers cannot call authoritative damage, ammo, score, checkpoint, objective, bomb, or terminal commit methods and suppress duplicate event IDs.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester: start from title through loadout, loading, briefing, and fresh deployment.
